CI's fingerprint 556 = 1 + 6 + 549 is ONE Popen.wait caught in flight -- the victim's own call(2.0), a complete six-term ramp 0.001 -> 0.032, then saturation at the cap -- reproduced independently by implementer and reviewer with probes containing no repo code. EACH EXCLUSION IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT AN ARGUMENT: psutil.Process.wait measured at 0 recorded calls versus thousands for a real Popen.wait under the identical patch, because psutil._psposix.wait_pid_posix binds _sleep=time.sleep as a function DEFAULT at import (rot mode #5 in a third-party library), and the pidfd branch contains no sleep at all -- so the exclusion survives rot mode #4 and is environment-independent; restart.py:147 and daemon.py:1382 FALSIFIED (flat 0.05, no ramp, cannot produce the observed prefix); the leaked-module-global leg is structurally impossible (saas_client.py has two module-level names, backoff is local at :466-468). THE INSTRUMENT WAS CONTROLLED BEFORE ITS SILENCE WAS TRUSTED, which is what makes this absence claim admissible: traceback capture on the recorder, a synthetic positive control (standalone Popen.wait leak attributed to subprocess.py:2047 in _wait) and a REAL one (a live, stack-named leak at sync/batch.py:674 via background.py's final-sync thread -- WP04 E24/E25, issue #3130 leaks 1-2). Closure argument: the recorder is side_effect on the SAME mock whose call_count raises, so the instrument's blind spots are a subset of the failure's; the one real exception (side_effect reassignment) measured at 0 sites (grep -rn 'sleep\.side_effect\s*=' tests/sync/ -> 0). THE FLOOR WAS RECORDED BEFORE THE BUDGET STARTED, as outcome F-b: could NOT be reproduced locally, with TEN selections enumerated and each carrying its collected count (single test 1; whole file 53; tracker cone serial and -n auto 468; full tests/sync at -n auto and serial 2388 each; daemon-siblings + victim serial and -n 2 171; CI-replica at -n auto and -n 4 2108 + 11 skipped). WP06 and #3136 both said 'eleven'; the enumeration resolves to TEN, corrected by WP14's reviewer. The real victims, quoted from CI job 91126025663 / run 30621215287, are test_exponential_backoff_intervals ('assert 71 == 3', gw5) and test_saas_client_origin.py::test_429_retries_then_raises ('Expected 'sleep' to be called once. Called 556 times.', gw2). WHAT IS NOT MET, stated plainly: FR-005's acceptance also asks for a reproduction that shows the call count MOVING on the victim -- the count before and after, both quoted. That was obtained only on synthetic probes, never on either real victim; the producer is named but the CALL SITE IS UNATTRIBUTED, and the contention reproduction matching CI's 4-vCPU runner was deliberately not attempted and handed forward. That gap is what takes #3115's sync half to deferred-with-followup under FR-010(b) and #3136, not a defect in this FR's negative. *** QUALIFIED AT PRE-MERGE SQUAD. *** This criterion records floor outcome F-b, 'could NOT be reproduced locally' across ten enumerated selections, and that non-reproduction is the load-bearing reason FR-010's reproduction conjunct fails and the mission defers. An independent reviewer REPRODUCED IT LOCALLY ON THE FIRST ATTEMPT, running the mission's own committed CI-replica selection on dee9e29fd8. Note also that FR-005's enumerated 'CI-replica' collected 2108 passed + 11 skipped = 2119 items while the committed script collects 2112 + 12 = 2124 -- two different selections are both called CI-replica, and the one that reproduces is the committed one. THE DEFERRAL MAY STILL BE CORRECT: one local red is an observation, not an attribution, and the call site remains unnamed. But 'could not be reproduced locally' is not true of this mission's own committed shard and must not be restated as though it were. *** PLUGIN DEFECT FOUND AT PRE-MERGE SQUAD, AND WHY THIS CRITERION SURVIVES IT. *** Three of the five mutation plugins -- attribute_sleep_count, neutralise_reset_token_manager and nonterminating_dispatch -- incremented their suppression counters in xdist WORKERS while running the non-arrival check in the CONTROLLER. Measured with a controlled diagnostic (a 3-test selection whose first test asserts it received the MUTATED result, so a pass proves the patch was live in the worker): symbol reached, serial = 3 passed, exit 0, quiet; symbol reached, -n 2 = 3 passed, exit 1, 'suppressed ZERO calls'; symbol NOT reached = exit 1 NO VERDICT in both. The last two cells are INDISTINGUISHABLE -- under xdist the guard had no discriminating power in either direction, which is worse than noisy. A worker's session.exitstatus mutation is discarded by xdist, so forcing exit from the worker was never an option; fixed via config.workeroutput -> pytest_testnodedown. hang_a_fast_test was already correct, because it proves arrival of a test REPORT and xdist aggregates those; a suppression COUNTER rides on no report and needed an explicit channel. THE DIRECTION IS WHAT MATTERS HERE: the bug forced FALSE NO-VERDICTS -- loud, exit 1 -- and never false greens. An affected run proved nothing; it did not assert something untrue. SO THIS CRITERION IS UNAFFECTED, and the proof is in its own numbers rather than in a claim about how it was run: a run bitten by this defect reports ZERO suppressed calls at every site, and this criterion's recorded per-site counts are non-zero. GAP ACKNOWLEDGED: this evidence does not state whether its run was serial or under -n, which NFR-001 requires, so the distribution is INFERRED from the counters rather than read off the record. INSTRUMENT INERTNESS, measured because an instrument that perturbs what it observes is a worse problem than the blind spot it was fixed for: test OUTCOMES are unaffected. Against a 15-test synthetic surface covering side_effect as exception class / exception instance / iterable / callable / mock.DEFAULT, return_value, call_args, patch.object, autospec, monkeypatch.undo, the string-target form, raising=False and non-sleep attributes: 15 passed both ways, per-node outcomes identical. Against a real selection it is NOT measuring (tests/kernel): '196 passed, 4 skipped' both ways, 199 nodes, per-node outcomes identical, md5 a82372efdec52d3f0e3f49576c26e685 -- while still recording 9 activations / 6 calls on the synthetic surface, so it observes without perturbing. THE CAVEAT, stated explicitly rather than left implied: the process EXIT STATUS does change, 0 -> 1, on a selection it is not measuring, because the non-arrival guard fires as contract clause 4 specifies. So it is inert with respect to test outcomes and NOT with respect to exit status -- do not load it onto a selection you are not measuring and then trust the exit code. Its zero-count message is now honest about its own reach: it names the 2 mechanisms it observes and the 4 it does not, and states that a sleep substituted by any of the 4 produces exactly the same zero.

THE DIRECTION IS WHAT MATTERS HERE: the bug forced FALSE NO-VERDICTS -- loud, exit 1 -- and never false greens. An affected run proved nothing; it did not assert something untrue. SO THIS CRITERION IS UNAFFECTED, and the proof is in its own numbers rather than in a claim about how it was run: a run bitten by this defect reports ZERO suppressed calls at every site, and this criterion's recorded per-site counts are non-zero. GAP ACKNOWLEDGED: this evidence does not state whether its run was serial or under -n, which NFR-001 requires, so the distribution is INFERRED from the counters rather than read off the record.
